info.title: Amrutam Telemedicine API
info.description: Backend services for the Amrutam Telemedicine platform.

get.description: Returns 200 when the application process is running and responding to requests.
Returns 200 when all core dependencies (PostgreSQL, Redis if configured) are connected and accepting traffic.
Exposes application, HTTP, database connection pool, and business metrics in standard Prometheus text format (version=0.0.4). Labels are strictly low-cardinality.

401.description: Metrics access token required or invalid.

get.description: Returns 200 when the application process is running and responding to requests.

401.description: Metrics access token required or invalid.

post.description: Registers a new patient account and associated profile in a single atomic transaction. Enforces consistent email normalization and unique email constraints. Returns a sanitized profile response with password and secrets excluded.

201.description: User account and profile successfully created.

error.message: A user with this email address already exists.

post.summary: Authenticate user and issue access token
post.description: Authenticates a user using normalized email and password. Upon successful verification, returns a signed JWT access token with short expiry. Never exposes password hash, raw tokens in logs, or specific error details that allow enumeration.

200.description: User successfully authenticated; access token returned.

403.description: User account is inactive.

get.description: Retrieves account and demographic profile information for the authenticated user. Requires a valid Bearer access token. Sensitive credentials and secrets are excluded.

401.description: Authentication token missing, invalid, or expired.

403.description: User account is inactive.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of public doctor profiles with deterministic sorting (created_at DESC, id DESC). Supports filtering by specialization, name, and verification status. Strictly bounded to a maximum of 100 items per page. Sensitive data is redacted.

post.description: Creates one or more availability time slots for the authenticated doctor. Enforces rejection of past intervals, internal overlaps within the request batch, and database-level overlap constraints against existing slots.

schema.title: Response Create Doctor Slots Endpoint Api V1 Doctors Me Slots Post

400.description: Invalid time interval or slot in the past.

403.description: Caller does not hold the doctor role.

404.description: Doctor profile not found for authenticated user.

409.description: Slot interval overlaps with an existing slot.

patch.description: Updates an unbooked availability slot interval or changes its status ('available' / 'blocked'). Enforces ownership (only owning doctor or admin can modify) and guarantees that booked slots cannot be edited.

400.description: Invalid time interval or update in the past.

403.description: Caller lacks permission to modify this slot.

409.description: Slot is already booked or overlaps with an existing slot.

delete.description: Deletes an unbooked availability slot. Enforces ownership (only owning doctor or admin can delete) and guarantees that booked slots cannot be deleted.

403.description: Caller lacks permission to delete this slot.

409.description: Slot is already booked and cannot be deleted.

get.description: Retrieves public professional details and consultation fee for a specific doctor. Sensitive information including license numbers, credentials, and contact details are strictly redacted.
Retrieves availability slots for a doctor with optional date range and status filters. Defaults to returning available future slots in chronological order.

post.description: Reserves an available doctor slot and creates a consultation within one PostgreSQL transaction. A patient identity and Idempotency-Key header are required. Matching completed retries replay the original booking with HTTP 200.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Unique request key to guarantee at-most-once execution
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: Unique request key to guarantee at-most-once execution

403.description: Caller is not a patient.

400.description: The Idempotency-Key header was missing or invalid.

get.description: Retrieve a booking subject to patient ownership or doctor assignment policy.

403.description: Caller is not the patient, assigned doctor, or an administrator.

post.summary: Cancel an eligible booking and release its slot
post.description: Patients may cancel only their own future bookings that remain in the booked state; administrators may perform the same operational action. The cancelled consultation is retained and its slot becomes available atomically.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Unique request key to guarantee at-most-once execution

400.description: The Idempotency-Key header was missing or invalid.

403.description: Caller is not the patient owner or an administrator.

409.description: Booking cannot be cancelled in its current state.

get.description: Retrieve consultation detail subject to patient ownership or doctor assignment.

403.description: Caller is not the patient, assigned doctor, or an administrator.

post.description: Transition consultation status from 'booked' to 'confirmed'. Only the assigned doctor or an administrator can confirm the appointment.

403.description: Caller is not the assigned doctor or administrator.

post.description: Transition consultation status from 'confirmed' to 'in_progress'. Only the assigned doctor can start the consultation session.

403.description: Caller is not the assigned doctor.

post.description: Transition consultation status from 'in_progress' to 'completed'. Only the assigned doctor can mark the consultation complete.

403.description: Caller is not the assigned doctor.

post.description: Transition consultation status from 'confirmed' to 'no_show'. Only the assigned doctor or an administrator can record a patient no-show.

403.description: Caller is not the assigned doctor or administrator.

post.summary: Cancel an eligible consultation and release its slot
post.description: Patients may cancel only their own future consultations in the 'booked' state; administrators may perform the same action. Releases the slot atomically and returns the preserved cancelled consultation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Unique request key to guarantee at-most-once execution
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: Unique request key to guarantee at-most-once execution

400.description: The Idempotency-Key header was missing or invalid.

403.description: Caller is not the patient owner or an administrator.

409.description: Consultation cannot be cancelled in its current state.

post.summary: Issue or amend prescription for an eligible consultation
post.description: Issues a medical prescription with structured line items. Only the doctor assigned to the consultation may issue or amend a prescription. Consultations must be in 'in_progress' or 'completed' status. Creates prescription and items atomically.

403.description: Caller is not the assigned doctor.

409.description: Consultation is not in an eligible status.

put.description: Corrects or amends an issued prescription. Increments the version counter and atomically updates medication items. Restricted to the assigned doctor.

403.description: Caller is not the assigned doctor.

409.description: Consultation is not in an eligible status.

get.summary: Retrieve the prescription for a consultation
get.description: Returns the prescription issued for a consultation. Accessible only to the patient recipient, the assigned doctor, or an administrator.

403.description: Caller lacks permission to view this prescription.

post.summary: Initiate payment intent for an appointment consultation
post.description: Initiates a payment intent through the simulated payment provider adapter. Requires patient authentication and an Idempotency-Key header. External provider calls occur outside database locks; matching completed retries return original results.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Unique request key to guarantee at-most-once execution
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: Unique request key to guarantee at-most-once execution

403.description: Caller is not the patient who booked the consultation.

409.description: Consultation already paid or in an ineligible status.

get.summary: Retrieve a prescription by its direct identifier
get.description: Returns the complete prescription and structured medication items. Restricted to the patient who received the prescription, the issuing doctor, or an administrator.

403.description: Caller is not authorized to view this prescription.

get.description: Returns payment details and current status. Automatically reconciles pending/timeout transactions if required. Accessible to the paying patient, doctor, or administrator.

403.description: Caller lacks permission to view this payment.

post.summary: Process external payment provider webhook callback
post.description: Idempotently processes payment status events from the payment provider adapter. Verifies HMAC webhook signatures and enforces valid state machine transitions.

schema.title: Response Payment Webhook Endpoint Api V1 Payments Webhooks  Provider  Post

404.description: Associated payment record was not found.
